city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: Summerville: 16.3% of residents were 65 or older in the 2020 census (up from 10.5% in 2010); elevation 43 ft, humid subtropical climate with about 52.7 in of rain a year; Summerville Historic District is on the National Register of Historic Places; the town sits in the Middleton Place-Summerville seismic zone.

neighborhoods.value: Nexton and Cane Bay Plantation are large Berkeley County master-planned communities with Summerville addresses; not confirmed to be inside Town limits (Nexton annexation vote was postponed, undated). No official neighborhood list found.

place_entities.value: Colonial Dorchester State Historic Site (300 State Park Road, Summerville - tabby fort, St. George's bell tower, log wharf on the Ashley River); Summerville Azalea Park (Flowertown Festival site; walking tour); Summerville Medical Center; Summerville Historic District (NRHP).

permit_office.value: Town of Summerville handles permits for parcels inside Town limits (Permitting page: 200 South Main Street, 843-871-6000, Building Permits guidelines section). Unincorporated parcels (the Summerville ZIP spans Dorchester, Berkeley, Charleston counties): Dorchester County Building Services, 500 N. Main St, (843) 832-0011. Confirm by parcel.
